issues.title: Invalid turn time made planning impossible
issues.body:
At one point no force could plan their turns.

I logged in as the relevant (`Can submit orders`) role for each force, and confirmed it wasn't possible.  It was possible to choose a state, then speed, then click on `Plan Turn`.  But, no planning marker appeared.

On investigation, it was, however, possible to plan the turn for an aircraft.

Aircraft can travel an unlimited distance which lead me to thinking the issue could be related to the turn time allowance.

When I opened the Admin Page, I saw that the `Game Turn Time` just contained spaces - no digits at all.

Shortly before the issue arose, I did change the `planning allowance` from `one hour` to `twenty minutes`.  I'm almost certain this interaction caused the issue, but I don't know how.

In the admin pages we shouldn't allow the overview to be saved if there aren't recognisable (non-zero) times for game turn and planning allowance.  Plus, in the game we should throw an error if we try to plan a turn but there is a zero turn time.

comments.body:
It was impossible to plan the turn for a ship with a turn time of zero.  I've made a [change](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/833) to popup a warning if this happens during a game.

But, we should prevent the `Game controller` from entering a turn time of zero.  So, we should modify the `setting-overview` page so that it isn't possible to enter a zero value (or empty string) for `Wargame turn time` or `Real time planning allowance`.

If an empty string (or full set of zeroes) is entered, I suggest we display the previous valid value (which I think is in the `prevOverview` variable.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/121882257-3a829180-cd08-11eb-8858-f1817a693f8a.png)
